items.title: Buddy Burns Interview, 1958-08-14
items.q: Well, T.O. or Bach K, well I just know of them.

ctx.x: Do you remember any of the men before him like T.O. or Bach K?
Well, T.O. or Bach K, well I just know of them. Johnny Dodds. Johnny Dodds of him. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. He left a good while ago. I remember about him though.
Do you remember Georgia Boy? Georgia Boy, yeah.
